subject: xxhash: add ARM SVE intrinsic implementation
perf_evidence: Commit introduces an ARM SVE XXH3 implementation as a performance path; its message says later patches improve it further.
change_summary: Adds SVE vector dispatch and SVE accumulator/scramble intrinsics to XXH3.

units.name: public XXH3_64bits, 256 bytes, new SVE implementation versus prior vector path
units.evidence: Alive2 cannot translate llvm.aarch64.sve.ptrue.nxv2i1 in the changed SVE target.

notes: Unchanged non-SVE AArch64 and x86 XXH64 controls pass but do not prove the added SVE algorithm.
